verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a transcription API service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack documents only REST/OpenAPI endpoints, a WebSocket live mode and batch webhooks. The llms.txt probe shows only a truncated heading fragment ("## MCP C") with no content tying an official MCP server to Scribe or showing how to connect an agent, so this is not affirmative evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
